<a id="f205"></a>
#### F205. `frontend/ui/annotated-export.js` (changed)

The "Download annotated…" button no longer writes flags into the page's copy of the export; it reads the file from the server's `GET /export` in parts, joins them and saves the result, with a progress bar and an error shown on the save line if it fails. **Why:** Plan §5 (the page no longer holds the export; the download is rebuilt from stored rows) and §8c (the download answers in parts, joined into a Blob, starting over if the data changes); O6. Commit 8757068.

| ID | Item | Change | What changed | Why | Compare |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F205.1 | `(top of file)` | added | Module comment rewritten to say the server builds the file in parts and the page joins them; imports of the old export format and page state replaced by the parts reader, the API client's `fetchExportPart` and sign-in, error helpers and the shared progress bar. | Plan §5 and §8c; O6, O26. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-5ab8601c1d3d1d092534e6838f528575b2987598c13d46fe96310dfa32ce7a01R1) |

<a id="f207"></a>
#### F207. `frontend/ui/file-viewer.js` (added)

New module for the file viewer: a file card opens a modal that asks the server for the file's short-lived address, downloads its text, and shows it by kind without running any code in it, with a download link and, for web pages, a 'Show source' switch. **Why:** Plan §4 (opening a card shows the file on the page, never running its code, with a download link) and step 10 of §10. Commit 8757068.

<a id="f208"></a>
#### F208. `frontend/ui/flag-edits.js` (changed)

A flag save now uses the server's reply: the message's session, counted again, replaces the page's copy, the views are redrawn from it and Review asks for its page again. The message being saved is looked up among Review's current rows, and flipping the show switches marks Review as needing a fresh request. **Why:** Plan §5 (the page no longer holds all messages) and §6 (a flag save recounts its session in the same request); O21 (after a save only that session is refreshed). Commit 8757068.

The Upload page's steps now prepare each file in a Web Worker (slimmed and compressed) before sending it, show one bar for preparing then sending across the batch, send a batch's files in their order, and run the scan by cursor. Drawing the downloaded timeline and downloading it moved out: the timeline is now read by ui/timeline-load.js. **Why:** Plan §7b (slim in the browser), §8 (the scan by time limit and cursor), §8b (bars on real progress) and §5 (the page no longer downloads the whole export); bug B7 (commit a1635fe) for the send order. Commit 8757068.

Replaces load-flow.js's removed `applyExportText` and `downloadTimeline`. Commit 8757068.

<a id="f218"></a>
#### F218. `frontend/ui/views/analytics.js` (changed)

The Analytics tab now computes three analyses (friction, session length, idle time) in the page from the sessions' counts in 50 ms turns, resumable when left and reopened, and asks the server for the other two (rate over time, time of day), repeating while the server answers 'working'. The old chunked computation over all messages is gone. **Why:** Plan §5c (three in the page from sessions, two on the server) and §8c (every analysis can stop part-way and carry on); §8b explains the old fixed chunks were replaced by a time limit. Commit 8757068.

#### F219. `frontend/ui/views/calendar.js` (changed)

The Calendar is now drawn from each session's stored counts under the current view, so a session crossing midnight shows the same flags on both days; drawing is a generator that can run in 50 ms turns; and one delegated click handler replaces per-element listeners. A flag icon now opens Review filtered to that flag, with the session's rows highlighted. **Why:** Plan §5 and §6 (the Calendar from sessions alone, same flags on each day) and §8b (drawing in turns); bug B5 (commit 2359ce0) for the highlighting; Q6 for the flag filter. Commit 8757068.

#### F221. `frontend/ui/views/header.js` (changed)

Fills the line under the page title ("N conversations, M messages, first day to last day"). The first and last days now come from the earliest session start and latest session end, and the date range is left out when there are no sessions. **Why:** Part of the page rewrite in commit 8757068 (§5, step 11), which has no message of its own. Inferred: computing two extremes avoids building every session's list of days, and the empty case no longer prints "undefined to undefined".

| ID | Item | Change | What changed | Why | Compare |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F221.1 | `(top of file)` | added | The import changes from `localDaysTouched` to `localDateKey`. | The new `renderSubtitle` formats only two dates instead of listing every day each session touches. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3b5b7012ca673849acc9f27342fff9128daa63ae31930380ffff5b7beaddc81fR4) |
| F221.2 | `renderSubtitle` | changed | Now finds the earliest start and latest end over all sessions and formats each as a local date; with no sessions it omits the range. Before, it listed every local day every session touched, sorted them, and took the first and last. | Inferred: same result for non-empty data with less work, and a correct line with no sessions; no plan section or commit message states the reason. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3b5b7012ca673849acc9f27342fff9128daa63ae31930380ffff5b7beaddc81fR12) |

<a id="f222"></a>
#### F222. `frontend/ui/views/review.js` (changed)

Runs the Review tab. Before, it filtered, sorted and paged every one of your messages held in the page. Now it asks the server for one page of 50 rows at a time (`GET /messages`), following cursors part by part. It keeps only the rows on screen and each page's starting cursor, shows a progress bar, and leaves drawing the table to a new module, ui/render/review-table.js. **Why:** §5 and §5b: messages load only as a view shows them, and Review's filtering moves to the server; §8b and §8c: requests answer in parts with a cursor, one cursor kept per page of 50, "at least N pages" until the count is done. Highlighting by flag (B5) came in commit 2359ce0; logging replaced requests' failures (B8) was made before the page's first commit, 8757068.

#### F224. `frontend/ui/widgets/status-indicators.js` (changed)

The page's progress and status lines. It gains one shared progress-bar component, `createProgressBar`, with a clock worded as time spent ("· 12 s so far") and a striped state for waits that cannot be measured; the load screen's bar is now one instance of it. The old one-off label and fill helpers, the measured-state switch and the timeline-download progress are removed. **Why:** §8b: every wait shows a bar that moves only on real progress, with a clock the page keeps itself, and every measured bar clears the striped state (which the old scan bar never did); O26 (one shared component, page agent).

<a id="f225"></a>
#### F225. `frontend/workers/prepare-upload.js` (added)

New file: the Web Worker (a background thread of the page) that prepares one chosen file for sending. It receives the file and passes it to `slimFile`, posting each progress and result message back to the page. **Why:** §7b and §8b: slimming runs in a Web Worker so the page's bar and clock keep moving. Its `message` listener is one of the reasons for the failing activity-inventory test (Q2).

| ID | Item | Change | What changed | Why | Compare |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F225.1 | `(whole file)` | added | New: listens for the page's message with the file, runs `slimFile` on it, and posts every message slimFile produces back to the page. | §7b: preparing the file in a Web Worker. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-dd7481b82e1b8b12f3a76c29f23caac1d3fcc1e02dd3fadf49c98285a350f476) |

<a id="f226"></a>
#### F226. `frontend/workers/slim-stream.js` (added)

New file: reads a chosen export as a stream, parses it one conversation at a time with the vendored @streamparser/json, slims each conversation (core/slim-export.js) and gzip-compresses the result with the browser's built-in CompressionStream, reporting progress at most every half second. **Why:** §7b: the page sends only what the server keeps, compressed (63.5 MB to about 2.8 MB measured in Node); §8b: no step grows with the file, and progress is reported every 0.5 s.

| ID | Item | Change | What changed | Why | Compare |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F226.1 | `slimFile` | added | New: entry point. Runs the slimming and posts 'done' with the compressed file and counts, 'not_export' when the file is not an export the page can slim, or 'failed' naming the error. | §7b; O18: a file the worker cannot slim is sent as it is and the server reports what is wrong. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3d72631abc49af07e972eebbd3b161cd50775a652d40fc5cd37b4c028e355208R28) |
| F226.2 | `slim` | added | New: wires the file stream to the parser and the gzip compressor, posts progress every half second, and on failure aborts the compression (logging the expected abort of its reader) and cancels the file read before rethrowing. | §7b, §8b; the exception rule (the expected abort is logged, not dropped). | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3d72631abc49af07e972eebbd3b161cd50775a652d40fc5cd37b4c028e355208R37) |
| F226.3 | `parseInto` | added | New: reads the file piece by piece, holds the first pieces until the start of the text says whether it is a bare list or a saved timeline, then feeds the parser and passes slimmed text on; an empty file is 'not an export'. | O19: slimming keeps the file's outer shape, so the parser's paths depend on which shape it is. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3d72631abc49af07e972eebbd3b161cd50775a652d40fc5cd37b4c028e355208R67) |
| F226.4 | `write` | added | New: feeds one piece to the parser and throws its first failure. | Stops at the first parse or slimming error. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3d72631abc49af07e972eebbd3b161cd50775a652d40fc5cd37b4c028e355208R97) |
| F226.5 | `makeParser` | added | New: builds the streaming parser for the file's shape; each conversation it emits is slimmed at once; invalid JSON becomes a 'not an export' error. | §7b, §8b: one conversation slimmed per step, using @streamparser/json (MIT). | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3d72631abc49af07e972eebbd3b161cd50775a652d40fc5cd37b4c028e355208R104) |
| F226.6 | `send` | added | New: hands slimmed text to the compressor one piece at a time, counting bytes. | §8b: one piece compressed per step. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3d72631abc49af07e972eebbd3b161cd50775a652d40fc5cd37b4c028e355208R135) |
| F226.7 | `collect` | added | New: reads the compressor's output as it arrives, counting compressed bytes. | §8b: progress includes bytes compressed. | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-3d72631abc49af07e972eebbd3b161cd50775a652d40fc5cd37b4c028e355208R147) |

<a id="f227"></a>
#### F227. `infra/template.yaml` (changed)

The AWS deployment template. The MessageFlags table and every reference to it are removed, PUT requests are now routed to the API and allowed by its cross-origin (CORS) rules, and the processing function's memory becomes a parameter, 512 or 1,769 MB. **Why:** §3 and step 1: flags move onto the message rows, so the table goes. B10: editing details uses PUT, which was never routed, so it could not work on AWS. §7 and step 12: processing is to be measured at both memory sizes (commit e34cedd). The AWS measurements are not yet done (Q1).

| ID | Item | Change | What changed | Why | Compare |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| F227.2 | `MessageFlagsTable` | removed | Removed: the DynamoDB table that held flags apart from messages. | §3: flags move onto the message rows; the table was empty (Q1 counted 0 items). | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-0c5449afaa5a806f009b696ba915c7942cced1b20b6f0672b4b509fa58a15989L236) |
| F227.3 | `ApiFunction` | changed | Loses the message-flags table setting and its access policy; gains a PUT route for every path. | §3 (table removed); B10 (PUT never routed). Per-field write limits per function were not added (Q7). | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-0c5449afaa5a806f009b696ba915c7942cced1b20b6f0672b4b509fa58a15989L359) |
| F227.4 | `ProcessUploadFunction` | changed | Memory now comes from `ProcessingMemory`; the message-flags table setting and policy are removed; the storage policy's comment now says it reads and deletes the upload and writes the kept files, not the old added-messages objects. | §7 and step 12 (memory); §3 (table removed); §3 and §7 (upload deleted once processed, files stored under files/…). | [diff](https://github.com/Telotrope/conversation-timeline/compare/3ae3c16ba50676a0b70788d297db485c45127473...b2dc6831443785b8e6872b444671cff15b7e97db#diff-0c5449afaa5a806f009b696ba915c7942cced1b20b6f0672b4b509fa58a15989R417) |
